mapper.select: select * from express_template_shipping_to where express_template_id = #{templateId} and is_deleted = 0

update.foreach: update express_template_shipping_to set shipping_cost = #{item.shippingCost}, update_by = #{item.updateBy}, update_time = #{item.updateTime} where id = #{item.id}

mapper.update: update express_template_shipping_to set is_deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where express_template_id = #{templateId}
